title: The added penalty is not a nonnegative normal reserve
statement: W=delta[(|sym B|^2+a z^2)^2-|sym B|^4] is pointwise nonnegative but can have negative variational gap. For EVERY a>=1,e=1/[4(a+1)],M=[[1,e],[-e,0]],rank-oneR=[[1,0],[e,0]],W_doubleprime(M)[R,R]=4delta a e^2[-3+(2+12a)e^2]<0. Actual plane-wave phi=(1,e)sinx,G=Rcosx gives DeltaW=delta a e^2[-9/4+(19+99a)e^2/8]<0. The exact same wave has positive FULL corrected Jensen gap in literal source controls. Global corrected QC rests on convex Q0 plus dilated-metric curvature absorbing actual Hodge error,not on W having nonnegative gap. Source also receives mixed four-wave actual gradients/Hodge potentials;finite controls check the construction,not its universal analytic theorem.

requires: delta>0,a>=1 and exact prescribed W,actual mean/rank-one periodic gradient above.
